def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for col,cs in cells.items():
        anchor=max(cs)  # bottom-most, then rightmost
        others=[p for p in cs if p!=anchor]
        if others:
            # direction sign from anchor to a spread of others
            dr=others[0][0]-anchor[0]; dc=others[0][1]-anchor[1]
            if dr==0 and dc==0: dr,dc=-1,1
            if dc==0: dc=1
            dr=-1 if dr<0 or dr==0 else -1
            # normalize to upward ray
            dr=-abs(dr) if dr!=0 else -1
            dc=dc//abs(dc)
        else:
            dr,dc=-1,-1
        r,c=anchor[0]+dr,anchor[1]+dc
        while 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W:
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=col
            r+=dr; c+=dc
    # erase same-color cells not on ray
    for col,cs in cells.items():
        r,c=max(cs); dr,dc=None,None
        # recompute ray membership
        on={(r,c)}
        others=[p for p in cs if p!=(r,c)]
        if others:
            v=(others[0][0]-r, others[0][1]-c)
            if v[1]==0: v=(-1,1)
